---
title: "For Students"
---

I am the Director of Graduate Studies for the Department of Economics. This page collects the links and answers I most often send to students.

## Prospective graduate students

The department's pages are the authoritative source on the programs, requirements, and how to apply:

- [PhD program](https://socialsciences.uoregon.edu/economics/graduate-programs/phd)
- [Master's program](https://socialsciences.uoregon.edu/economics/graduate-programs/masters)
- [Funding](https://socialsciences.uoregon.edu/economics/graduate-programs/funding)
- [Where our graduates go](https://socialsciences.uoregon.edu/economics/graduate-programs/career)
- [Division of Graduate Studies](https://graduatestudies.uoregon.edu/) (university-wide policies and application portal)

If those pages don't answer your question, email me with "Prospective student" in the subject line.

## Current graduate students

I'm happy to talk about research in industrial organization, health economics, public economics, and applied microeconomics more broadly, whether or not I'm on your committee. Email me to set up a time.

For questions about program requirements, milestones, and funding, start with the department's [graduate program pages](https://socialsciences.uoregon.edu/economics/graduate-programs) and then email me.

## Undergraduates

Course questions go through Canvas for the course. For anything else, email me.
